# aos7-evgap

唯讀彙總 node 目錄中的 `obs`、`must` JSONL 序號。輸出為一行 JSON；不補洞、不修改輸入。

## 第一次跑

在原型根目錄執行：

```sh
python3 packs/evgap/bin/aos7-evgap /path/to/node
python3 tests/run_all.py packs/evgap/tests
```

不存在的路徑或檔案輸入會以狀態碼 2 結束，且不輸出至 stdout。工具只讀取符合命名規則的常規 JSONL 檔及可選的 `state.json`；壞行列入 `bad`，不計入彙總。

"""Behavioral tests for the read-only evgap CLI."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

ENTRY = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "bin" / "aos7-evgap"


class EvgapTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.node = Path(self.temp.name) / "node"
        self.node.mkdir()

    def put(self, name, data):
        (self.node / name).write_bytes(data)

    def run_cli(self, path=None):
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ENTRY), str(self.node if path is None else path)],
                              stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=False)

    def result(self):
        process = self.run_cli()
        self.assertEqual(process.returncode, 0, process.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(process.stdout.count(b"\n"), 1)
        self.assertTrue(process.stdout.endswith(b"\n"))
        value = json.loads(process.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(set(value), {"v", "channels", "bad"})
        self.assertIs(type(value["v"]), int)
        self.assertEqual(value["v"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(set(value["channels"]), {"obs", "must"})
        for fields in value["channels"].values():
            self.assertEqual(set(fields), {"count", "first", "last", "missing", "dup",
                                           "next_seq", "unacked", "stale_next"})
        return value

    def test_counts_ranges_duplicates_and_state(self):
        self.put("obs.000000000009.jsonl", b'{"seq":4}\n{"seq":1}\n{"seq":4}\n{"seq":7}\n')
        self.put("obs.active.jsonl", b'{"seq":8}\n')
        self.put("must.000000000001.jsonl", b'{"seq":1}\n{"seq":3}\n{"seq":3}\n')
        self.put("must.active.jsonl", b'{"seq":5}\n')
        self.put("state.json", b'{"channels":{"obs":{"next_seq":8,"active_first":999},'
                               b'"must":{"next_seq":6,"acked_upto":2,"segments":[]}}}')
        value = self.result()
        self.assertEqual(value["bad"], [])
        self.assertEqual(value["channels"]["obs"], {
            "count": 5, "first": 1, "last": 8, "missing": [[2, 3], [5, 6]],
            "dup": [4], "next_seq": 8, "unacked": None, "stale_next": True,
        })
        self.assertEqual(value["channels"]["must"], {
            "count": 4, "first": 1, "last": 5, "missing": [[2, 2], [4, 4]],
            "dup": [3], "next_seq": 6, "unacked": 2, "stale_next": False,
        })

    def test_bad_lines_and_torn_priority(self):
        self.put("obs.000000000001.jsonl", b'{"seq":1}\n{"seq":true}\n{"seq":null}\n'
                 b'{"seq":2,"x":NaN}\n{"seq":\r 4}\n{"seq":7')
        self.put("obs.active.jsonl", b'{"seq":1}\n[]\n{"seq":0}\n'
                 b'{"seq":2,"x":Infinity}\n')
        value = self.result()
        self.assertEqual(value["channels"]["obs"], {
            "count": 3, "first": 1, "last": 4, "missing": [[2, 3]],
            "dup": [1], "next_seq": None, "unacked": None, "stale_next": None,
        })
        self.assertEqual(value["bad"], [
            {"file": "obs.000000000001.jsonl", "line": 2, "why": "no_seq"},
            {"file": "obs.000000000001.jsonl", "line": 3, "why": "no_seq"},
            {"file": "obs.000000000001.jsonl", "line": 4, "why": "bad_json"},
            {"file": "obs.000000000001.jsonl", "line": 6, "why": "torn"},
            {"file": "obs.active.jsonl", "line": 2, "why": "no_seq"},
            {"file": "obs.active.jsonl", "line": 3, "why": "no_seq"},
            {"file": "obs.active.jsonl", "line": 4, "why": "bad_json"},
        ])

    def test_invalid_channel_does_not_invalidate_other_channel(self):
        self.put("obs.active.jsonl", b'{"seq":1}\n')
        self.put("must.active.jsonl", b'{"seq":1}\n')
        self.put("state.json", b'{"channels":{"obs":{"next_seq":true},'
                               b'"must":{"next_seq":2,"acked_upto":0}}}')
        value = self.result()
        self.assertEqual(value["bad"], [{"file": "state.json", "line": None, "why": "bad_state"}])
        self.assertIsNone(value["channels"]["obs"]["next_seq"])
        self.assertIsNone(value["channels"]["obs"]["stale_next"])
        self.assertEqual(value["channels"]["must"]["unacked"], 1)
        self.assertIs(value["channels"]["must"]["stale_next"], False)

    def test_invalid_whole_state_and_empty_channels(self):
        self.put("state.json", b'{"channels":{"obs":{"next_seq":1},'
                               b'"must":{"next_seq":NaN}}}')
        value = self.result()
        self.assertEqual(value["bad"], [{"file": "state.json", "line": None, "why": "bad_state"}])
        for fields in value["channels"].values():
            self.assertEqual(fields, {"count": 0, "first": None, "last": None,
                                      "missing": [], "dup": [], "next_seq": None,
                                      "unacked": None, "stale_next": None})
        (self.node / "state.json").unlink()
        self.assertEqual(self.result()["bad"], [])

    def test_missing_and_file_inputs_have_empty_stdout(self):
        missing = self.run_cli(self.node / "missing")
        self.assertEqual((missing.returncode, missing.stdout), (2, b""))
        self.put("ordinary", b"data")
        file_input = self.run_cli(self.node / "ordinary")
        self.assertEqual((file_input.returncode, file_input.stdout), (2, b""))

    def test_filters_regular_files_and_preserves_read_only_input(self):
        record = self.node / "obs.000000000001.jsonl"
        self.put(record.name, b'{"seq":2}\n')
        self.put("obs.123.jsonl", b'{"seq":99}\n')
        (self.node / "obs.000000000002.jsonl").symlink_to(record.name)
        os.chmod(record, 0o444)
        os.chmod(self.node, 0o555)
        try:
            before = (self.node.stat().st_mode, self.node.stat().st_mtime_ns,
                      record.stat().st_mode, record.stat().st_mtime_ns, record.read_bytes(),
                      sorted(p.name for p in self.node.iterdir()))
            value = self.result()
            after = (self.node.stat().st_mode, self.node.stat().st_mtime_ns,
                     record.stat().st_mode, record.stat().st_mtime_ns, record.read_bytes(),
                     sorted(p.name for p in self.node.iterdir()))
            self.assertEqual(before, after)
            self.assertEqual(value["channels"]["obs"]["count"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(value["channels"]["obs"]["first"], 2)
        finally:
            os.chmod(self.node, 0o755)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
